posting.text:
One vendor outage just took Teams, Outlook, and Copilot at once. Everyone calls it a bad day for Microsoft. Wrong. That's the actual cost of single-vendor AI: you lose comms and reasoning in the same click. Rule: keep one non-Microsoft model wired behind a flag.
#Cloud #BigTech

bestPost.text:
Anthropic 发布 Sonnet 5.5，大家盯跑分，我盯默认值：模型越强，迁移成本越高，你的工作流被锁得越死， 模型是别人的，流程才是你的，默认用它之前，把回滚路径写成三行脚本，把成本折算成 API 单价，把切换窗口标进日历， 谁掌握默认，谁掌握你的利润。
#AI #DevTools
